pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū Tapode nhāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.3: tena kho pana samayena rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro sīsaṃ nhāyissāmīti Tapodaṃ gantvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.4: yāv' ayyā nhāyantīti ekamantaṃ paṭimānesi. bhikkhū yāva samandhakārā nhāyiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.5: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro vikāle sīsaṃ nhāyitvā nagaradvāre thakkite bahinagare vasitvā kālass' eva asambhinnena vilepanena yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.7: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ bhagavā etad avoca: kissa tvaṃ mahārāja kālass' eva āgato asambhinnena vilepanenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.8: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.9: atha kho bhagavā rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ dhammiyā kathāya . . . sampahaṃsesi. atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya . . . sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.10: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū rājānaṃ pi passitvā na mattaṃ jānitvā nhāyantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.14: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā rājānaṃ pi passitvā na mattaṃ jānitvā nhāyissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.15: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.16: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.17.1: yo pana bhikkhu oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyeyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.18: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū uṇhasamaye pariḷāhasamaye kukkuccāyantā na nhāyanti sedagatena gattena sayanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave uṇhasamaye pariḷāhasamaye oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.7: tatthāyaṃ samayo, diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo pariḷāhasamayo. ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.8: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gilānā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.2: gilānapucchakā bhikkhū gilāne bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.3: kacc' āvuso khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.4: pubbe mayaṃ āvuso oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyāma, tena no phāsu hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.5: idāni pana bhagavatā paṭikkhittan ti kukkuccāyantā na nhāyāma, tena no na phāsu hotīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.11: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||3||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū navakammaṃ katvā kukkuccāyantā na nhāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:4.2: te sedagatena gattena sayanti. cīvaraṃ pi senāsanaṃ pi dussati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:4.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave kammasamaye oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:4.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:4.8: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||4||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū addhānaṃ gantvā kukkuccāyantā na nhāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:5.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave addhānagamanasamaye oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:5.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:5.8: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||5||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū ajjhokāse cīvarakammaṃ karontā sarajena vātena okiṇṇā honti, devo ca thokaṃ thokaṃ phusāyati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.2: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā na nhāyanti, kilinnena gattena sayanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave vātavuṭṭhisamaye oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.7.1: yo pana bhikkhu oren' addhamāsaṃ nhāyeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.8: tatthāyaṃ samayo: diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti. ||6||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.8: cuṇṇena vā mattikāya vā nhāyati, payoge payoge dukkaṭaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.15: vassānassa paṭhamo māso, icc ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo pariḷāhasamayo 'ti nhāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.17: yassa vinā nhānena na phāsu hoti, gilānasamayo 'ti nhāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.19: antamaso pariveṇaṃ pi sammaṭṭhaṃ hoti, kammasamayo 'ti nhāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.21: addhayojanaṃ gacchissāmā 'ti nhāyitabbaṃ, gacchantena nhāyitabbaṃ, gatena nhāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.23: bhikkhū sarajena vātena okiṇṇā honti, dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni kāye patitāni honti, vātavuṭṭhisamayo 'ti nhāyitabbaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.2.1: ūnakaddhamāse ūnakasaññī aññatra samayā nhāyati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
